title: Wilder World launch price review
basis: New draft recommendations extend the current $3/$5/$7/$9/$12/$15/$19 fashion ladder and add a $29 vehicle tier. These are editorial pricing proposals, not market valuations or approved production prices.
assumptions: One purchase grants one selected edition/finish, not all nine.
All finishes of a product share one price; no rarity, gender or material surcharge.
All proposed lifetime supply sells at its stated price; this is a hypothetical gross sellout, not a forecast.
Reserved/reward units remain inside total supply. No deduction for them, fees, tax, discounts, royalties or costs is included.
Original collections, secondary trades and physical Frank Wilder goods are excluded.
A proposed price does not authorize minting, compatibility, gameplay benefits, source rights or launch.
